question: To what kind of person who has been tested over the course of one year must this teaching be given?
premises: The teaching is only to be given, not indiscriminately disclosed.
It is owed to one who has previously accomplished the required practice.
Such a person must have been tested for a full year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the year-long test is not specified here.
plain_english: This teaching is to be given to one who has previously accomplished it and has been tested for one year.
